mode: Existing dedicated Chromium tab; exact working-tree source routed into that tab; warm reloads only; no profile/storage clearing

startup.initialObservedDelivery: The preexisting page had the Phase 6 preview loader active, repository loader inactive, and a 13-module serial preview path; this was not a current-main baseline.
startup.paintTiming: First Paint, FCP, first native shell, first Hybrid shell and Home-card timing were unavailable from this warm-preview route.
startup.comparison: Not comparable: prior route was an older preview, and paint metrics were unavailable. No startup improvement or flash elimination claim is made.

navigation.scenario: Native Settings → Hub → search → YDesign owner → Back to same query/result/focus → Hub root → Standard Lampa Settings; root Back returned to native Settings without re-entry.
navigation.method: Native Lampa controller and keyboard flow; one initial search-field harness assumption was corrected to use the native keyboard confirmation flow.
navigation.limitations: A two-consecutive-run integrated scenario was not completed. Final repeated-run attempt lost the existing CDP/browser connection; no browser restart was attempted.

mockedServices: Trakt API and authentication endpoints blocked at the browser boundary
safety.storageIsolation: Not complete: Lampa Storage was not cleared or exported; do not treat these browser observations as disposable-storage evidence.

console.attribution: Unavailable; the earlier capture aggregated errors across routes and did not retain source details. Console cleanliness is not established.

viewport.interpretation: Existing browser viewport; screenshots/crops are not 1080p rendering or device acceptance.

finalBrowserState.evidence: After the final runner attempt, the existing CDP endpoint stopped responding and no process matching the dedicated profile remained. Runner cleanup reported route/mark removal errors. No Chromium process, tab, profile or server was restarted or replaced.
